items.title: Get in Line. Costco Is Rationing Motor Oil.
items.summary: Did you see that  Costco  Wholesale is rationing and massively jacking up prices for motor oil?  The Auto Wire, which broke the story, reports that the big club retailer made this move with its Kirkland Signature full synthetic motor oil.  Costco is also limiting at least one other petroleum-based product; sales of a six-quart case of Mobil 1 are capped at five per member.
